title: phragmipedium × stella
intro: Phragmipedium × stella, commonly known as the Stella orchid, is a hybrid orchid species known for its vibrant flowers. This plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been traditionally used for their health benefits. The health benefits of Phragmipedium × stella include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to aid in wound healing, antimicrobial properties, and its use as an antiviral agent.
